1825685.steps:
1)set DHCP lease time = 24 hrs.
2)Do a DHCP renew
3)Check the DHCP Flash writes count in the TSR.
1825685.title: DHCP leases are saved in to the Flash only when it is necessary.
1825685.description: This test is to verify current DHCP leases are saved in to the Flash not on all Probe intervals, but based on any network change happened after the previous probe.
1825685.result: Make sure DHCP lease flash writes count gets incremented only when there is a change in the network caused by DHCP Release/DHCP Renew, DHCP lease time expiry, DHCP server configuration change in the GUI.

1825687.steps:
